title: Probabilistic Fractions Skill Score and scale-aware spatial verification
description: Computes threshold-neighbourhood pFSS and a reproducible independent-Bernoulli reference distribution for a finite ensemble. Separates spatial displacement tolerance from probability calibration and requires scale-aware reporting.
explicit_non_claims: Does not establish operational forecast skill.
Does not compute CRPS, Brier, energy or variogram scores.
Independent Bernoulli null is not climatology or persistence.
No geospatial projection or longitude wrapping is performed.

uncertainty.method: percentile bootstrap over independent event blocks
uncertainty.resampling_unit: event_block_id; all cases from a selected block remain together
uncertainty.forbidden: individual grid cells as IID bootstrap units
